# AIUpdateInterface constructor: exact official-TU scratch handoff

2026-09-30, model=gpt-6-sol. This is scratch evidence, not a landing. The
remote claim on RVA 0x0027F4B0 is held by the parent. No tracked source,
ledger, symbol pin, or Git state was changed by this agent.

## Measured result

`build/sol_ai_canonical/eh_global_new_probe/AIUpdate.cpp` is the final scratch
source and compiles the actual
`AIUpdateInterface::AIUpdateInterface(Thing *, const ModuleData *)` symbol to
**1237/1237 exact bytes with 32 aligned relocations** at 0x0027F4B0. The
same compiled TU preserves **all 59 defensible pre-existing matched rows**;
the six refuted AI identities have now been retired and published by the
parent. `eh_global_new_probe/compare_65.csv` retains the historical 65-row
comparison as an audit, and `integration_binding_checklist.md` records all
32 relocations and EH states. Reproduce with:

```powershell
$env:PYTHONPATH = Join-Path (Get-Location) 'build\python-deps'
& 'C:\Users\spiky\.cache\codex-runtimes\codex-primary-runtime\dependencies\python\python.exe' tools/probe.py build/sol_ai_canonical/eh_global_new_probe/AIUpdate.cpp '??0AIUpdateInterface@@QAE@PAVThing@@PBVModuleData@@@Z' 0x0027F4B0 --size 1237
& 'C:\Users\spiky\.cache\codex-runtimes\codex-primary-runtime\dependencies\python\python.exe' build/sol_ai_ctor/compare_53.py build/sol_ai_canonical/eh_global_new_probe/AIUpdate.cpp build/sol_ai_canonical/eh_global_new_probe/compare_65.csv build/sol_ai_ctor/aiupdate_all_65.csv
```

The complete **32-relocation table** is
`build/sol_ai_canonical/loco_snapshot_view_probe/reloc_audit.txt`: each line gives
offset, COFF kind, retail absolute target, and object symbol. Kind 6 means
DIR32, kind 20 means REL32. It includes three SEH-frame data relocations,
retail ILT targets for every called body, all final base vtables, and the
array constructor/dtor callback pointers. It was generated by
`build/sol_ai_canonical/reloc_audit.py` from the exact scratch source.
Relocation *offset* and instruction identity are proved; native target
selection and runtime ownership remain subject to the issues below.

## Frozen scratch inputs and proposed production paths

| Scratch file | SHA-256 | Proposed production path |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `eh_global_new_probe/AIUpdate.cpp` | `64C999947DAD6BE23DB8329E119CB4E51F1D6EDB7DCA7D6E78321947BD99DDA3` | `game/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Update/AIUpdate.cpp` |
| `waypoint_view_probe/shim/GameLogic/Module/AIUpdate.h` | `618D655D28CA92B00E9C46D39E41D7E453951D0C85FA9CE38DB78D249D2DCB66` | `inputs/reference/shims/aiupdatelayout/GameLogic/Module/AIUpdate.h` |
| `loco_snapshot_view_probe/shim/GameLogic/LocomotorSet.h` | `B48D59CFB0024D9C9DD5803EDEF0439D9E0191A2C43B6430059D89E7798A60B6` | `inputs/reference/shims/aiupdatelayout/GameLogic/LocomotorSet.h` |
| `shim/Common/Module.h` | `C79EBA798E689A00C25422638CAA8C2BB1CED11074446C5A1FC90AA34E266802` | `inputs/reference/shims/aiupdatelayout/Common/Module.h` |
| `shim/GameLogic/Module/UpdateModule.h` | `1D3C9E03CBB92D05EB06AAD66154B9B0383BB751164C8E087244B5165F61ED63` | `inputs/reference/shims/aiupdatelayout/GameLogic/Module/UpdateModule.h` |

The scratch source's first-line `/Ibuild/...` path is diagnostic and must be
removed for production; the existing official TU already selects the
`aiupdatelayout` include root. The waypoint callback bridge still needs
documented routes, and the canonical LocomotorSet providers need native repair.
The old `AIUpdateInterfaceCtorThunk.cpp` owns the named naked-body emission:
remove/replace that definition when the official body lands. Do not add a
parallel class/TU. The landed AsciiString provider cleanup changed the
official `setName` assignment to `.set(...)`; this scratch source retains it.

## Why the 1237 bytes match

The scoped AI layout has five vptr subobjects at +0,+C,+10,+20,+24; Object
owns the two pathfind cells; a 0x24 LocomotorSet starts at +1A8; cur loco and
turret pointers stay +1CC and +1E8. The fields through +33C follow the
retail ctor and independent matched readers/writers. The scoped Module and
UpdateModule bases make ObjectModule construction and the first vptr stores
match. `Gen_0027AE50()` is declared `throw()` only for its constructor:
its separately matched 181-byte body at RVA0x0027AE50 has **zero calls**, no
allocations, and only scalar/static-address stores. Its destructor is implicit
and has no exception specification in the final scratch header. Removing the
constructor's `throw()` inserts a false EH state and yields 1249 bytes;
declaring the destructor `throw()` was unnecessary and was removed.

Retail uses a nontrivial 16×12-byte Coord3D waypoint array at AI+74. The ZH
`Coord3D` declaration is POD, and making it nontrivial across this TU fails
on `GameMessageArgumentType::location` union (C2620). A scoped derived
waypoint *bridge view* preserves 12-byte layout, existing Coord3D pointer
conversions, and all 59 retained rows. Its declared ctor/dtor make VC7 emit
the retail array helper and both callback DIR32 sites. Independent audit of
the matched canonical Coord3D bodies confirms ctor RVA0x00083330 is
`mov eax,ecx; ret` (3 bytes) and dtor RVA0x0005BC40 is `ret` (1 byte);
the AI ctor passes their ILTs 0x00016C93 and 0x0001364C at +55/+50, and
the retail AI destructor passes the same dtor ILT to array-delete helper.
The view is a bridge, **not** a claim of a second retail ctor/dtor identity.

The turret loop's condition intentionally repeats
`getAIUpdateModuleData()->m_turretData[i]`; using cached `d` changes VC7's
register schedule. The retail module-data string at +44 uses BFME's 8-byte
StringBase allocation header with a **16-bit length at data+4**. The
source-local `bfmeCtorStringIsEmpty` observes that four-byte handle and
emits the retail word compare. The ZH `AsciiString::isEmpty` emitted a byte
compare and left one byte short. The member view is read-only in this ctor;
`getAttackInfo` receives the same four-byte handle ABI.

## LocomotorSet external ABI and provider boundary

| Operation | Retail binding | Independently matched body | ABI and lifecycle |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Constructor | ILT0x0001CF8A → RVA0x001B7450/35 | `Rva001B7450::Rva001B7450` in `S2ZeroFillCtors.cpp` | `__thiscall`, receiver ECX, returns this EAX; installs vptr VA0x0109DF3C and clears +4/+8/+C/+10/+14/+18/+1C/+20. |
| Clear | ILT0x00023ECA → RVA0x001B98B0/113 | `Gen_001B98B0::bfmeClear` in `Bfme5CountedClears.cpp` | `void __thiscall()`; current canonical `LocomotorSet::clear` pin already routes here consistently. |
| Complete destructor | RVA0x001BA9E0/147 | `Gen_001BA9E0::~Gen_001BA9E0` in `Bfme5MultiMemberVectorDtors.cpp` | Virtual `__thiscall`; deleting wrapper RVA0x001BBC10/30 calls it. Restores vptr, clears, releases StringBase<char> members +1C/+18, frees vector+4, installs base vptr VA0x01073744. |
| Transfer virtual | ILT0x00003DA0 → RVA0x001BAAA0/576 | Currently `LocomotorSet::xfer(Xfer*)` in `LocomotorSet_xfer.cpp` | One pointer stack argument after ECX; ABI-equivalent to BFME `DoXfer(Xfer&)`, but selected virtual-name/provider route needs audit. |

The existing strong canonical ctor/clear/nonvirtual destructor from
`game/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Locomotor.cpp` use the ZH layout.
Address pins can reproduce a call byte while native linking still selects
those incompatible strong definitions; the exact constructor package must
report this debt and must not assert a linked LocomotorSet repair without a
coherent provider/vtable update. The nested destructor proof is in
`build/sol_link_repair/locomotor_abi_review.md`.

## Six identity corrections already published

These six rows have already been retired or rehomed by the parent. The table
is historical evidence for why the 65-row scratch comparison has only 59
defensible AI rows; it is not an instruction to edit their ledgers again.
Detailed proof and commands for the original five are in
`build/sol_ai_ctor/identity_corrections_plan.md`; this supersedes its old
"five/60" count. Each changed row retained truthful body coverage:

| RVA / extent | Current false AI identity or alias | Retail identity evidence and action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0x001B49AE / 10 | `AIUpdateInterface::setLastCommandSource` | Stores +3C, while exact ctor and matched AI command callers use +48. Keep existing `AnimateWindow::setAnimType` body/coverage; tombstone only duplicate AI name. |
| 0x0045DC60 / 13 | `AIUpdateInterface::setAttitude` | Stores +1F4, while seven named callers use true AI setter 0x0027DEF0/128 at +1F8. Replace with exact opaque setter bank `Rva0045DC60Setter.cpp`; tombstone false name. |
| 0x007F21F0 / 13 | `AIUpdateInterface::ignoreObstacleID` | Stores +154, while eight named callers use true getter 0x0026F940/7 at +164; adjacent setter0x0026F930 stores+164. Replace with exact opaque setter bank `Rva007F21F0Setter.cpp`; tombstone false name. |
| 0x002B1020 / 7 | Anonymous `?dup_` row's `object-symbol=AIUpdateInterface::getIgnoredObstacleID` | Reads +154; no owner proof. Retain distinct opaque body from `RvaUnknown154Getters.cpp`. |
| 0x004A3AA0 / 7 | Same false AI object-symbol alias | Distinct +154 getter; retain distinct opaque body from `RvaUnknown154Getters.cpp`. |
| 0x0047A250 / 7 | Anonymous `?dup_` row's `object-symbol=AIUpdateInterface::getAttitude` | Reads +1F4, while true AI attitude is +1F8. Scratch `build/sol_ai_ctor/Rva0047A250Getter.cpp` probes **exact 7/7, zero relocs**. Retain range under opaque getter owner. |

Do not infer a semantic class for any of the five opaque bodies from their
offset alone. The real AI setter and getter rows retain their existing names
until independently verified canonical replacements are ready. The separate
AIPathfind.cpp 0x00710DC0/7 getter still has a disputed AI+164 name and
needs its own identity audit; it is outside this TU's 65-row comparison.

## Integration blockers and required gates

1. **LocomotorSet virtual ABI is modeled; native providers remain.** Retail
   vtable VA0x0109DF3C slots are deleting dtor→0x001BBC10, no-op→
   0x001B7480, literal-name getter→0x001B7490, DoXfer/xfer→0x001BAAA0.
   Two independent exported BFME Snapshot-derived vtables prove base order
   `[dtor, LoadPostProcess, GetSnapshotName, DoXfer]`. The final scratch
   `LocomotorSet.h` uses an address-derived, no-data `Rva01073744SnapshotBase`
   view in that order and overrides all four slots. It keeps the ZH Snapshot
   for unrelated donor classes. A TU-wide corrected BFME Snapshot shadow
   failed C2259 on Money, TurretAI, Path, and other ZH-derived classes
   lacking BFME virtuals; giving those base slots guessed implementations
   merely to compile would fabricate behavior. The narrow view reproduces
   exact ctor/59 rows. Existing official `Locomotor.cpp` still emits
   incompatible strong ctor/clear and nonvirtual-dtor definitions; native
   provider repair is separate. Its `xferSelfAndCurLocoPtr` calls
   `xferSnapshot(this)` under the old ZH type; the BFME base subobject is at
   offset zero and retail transfer slot fourth, but that separate provider
   and Xfer dispatch require an independent ABI check before native linking.
   `docs/header_adoption.md` explicitly excludes multi-header `Snapshot`
   and `Coord3D` from automatic adoption pending evidence; run the staged
   source guard normally.
2. **Waypoint bridge routes.** Its two object symbols at relocation +50/+55
   must resolve to the *existing* Coord3D destructor/constructor ILTs, with
   documented `route=` aliases (or an equivalent accepted linker mechanism),
   without claiming another retail body. Check pin consistency and native
   selection. A macro rename of all Coord3D or a second canonical Coord3D
   definition is not acceptable.
3. **Other relocation routes.** `??0LocomotorSet` at +AE has no pin although
   retail calls ILT0x0001CF8A→0x001B7450. Its clear call at +274 already
   has a consistent pin ILT0x00023ECA→0x001B98B0. The +4B4 matched
   `Rva002EBF60Owner::findSorted` pointer-returning body has no pin;
   `symbols.csv` instead pins a conflicting LuaScriptEngine/int alias to
   RVA0x002EBF60 via ILT0x00035107. Reconcile identity/ABI and test route,
   not a guessed semantic return cast. Audit all remaining 32 relocations in
   `loco_snapshot_view_probe/reloc_audit.txt` for selected target/provider
   conflicts before landing.
4. **Ledger/source guards.** Parent owns `functions.csv`, durable
   `deleted_rows.csv` tombstones, `name_corrections.json` snapshots,
   identity evidence, `symbols.csv`, and Git. Use `add_match --replace-existing`
   for the ctor and `--correct-identity` for refuted rows as appropriate.
   Preserve every true extent. Run `check_csv`, `one_identity`, name guard,
   `adopt_header.py --fix-staged`/header adoption checks, scoped build for
   each changed body and the 59 retained rows, pin consistency, and the full
   shrink-only gate for all staged headers. No baseline additions or source
   fallback paths. Treat pre-existing unrelated STL/native link debt
   separately from new provider regressions.

The related LocomotorSet and Snapshot body proofs, source/header adoption
conflicts, and native-selected provider debt are documented in
`build/sol_ai_canonical/eight_body_handoff.md`. This exact AI constructor is
bank evidence. Its scratch exactness is not a native-linked conversion.

This reviews the unchanged exact source and headers hashed in `exact_handoff.md`
against current `symbols.csv` and `dir32_addresses.csv`. The constructor has
1237/1237 instruction bytes and 32 aligned relocation sites: 18 DIR32 and 14
REL32. Every compiled DIR32 addend is zero. The byte probe masks DIR32 sites,

scratch variant, `eh_global_new_probe/AIUpdate.cpp` (SHA-256
`64C999947DAD6BE23DB8329E119CB4E51F1D6EDB7DCA7D6E78321947BD99DDA3`),

New `eh_global_new_probe` uses `::new TurretAI(...)` and emits direct `??3@YAXPAX@Z`. | **Resolved by source form:** variant state-6 funclet is the exact 11-byte instruction shape `8B 45 F0 50 E8 rel32 59 C3`; existing global-delete pin selects body 00881EB0. complete destructor, and four-slot vtable are coherent in native-selected
sources. Then verify the full scoped/header gate and inspect generated EH

still owned by a different matched identity. The seven new vtable and two

# AIUpdate / LocomotorSet / Snapshot scratch handoff

2026-09-30, model=gpt-6-sol. All files named `build/sol_ai_canonical/...`
are untracked scratch. No tracked source, ledger, pin, standard object, or Git
state was changed by this lane. Parent holds the retail claims and owns
publication. **These exact probes are a bank bundle, not a safe native-linked
patch.** `exact_handoff.md` and `integration_binding_checklist.md` cover the AI
constructor's 32 relocations, seven EH cleanup states, and 59 retained rows.

## Frozen source receipts

| Scratch source | SHA-256 | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `eh_global_new_probe/AIUpdate.cpp` | `64C999947DAD6BE23DB8329E119CB4E51F1D6EDB7DCA7D6E78321947BD99DDA3` | AI ctor RVA0027F4B0: 1237/1237 instruction bytes, 32 aligned relocs; 59/59 defensible existing AI TU rows. The six false AI identities from the former 65-row inventory were already retired/published. |
| `loco_adoption_probe/LocomotorSetProvider.cpp` | `32BFA2BEBD8DFB1FB4D1D2A1966A63CD788E9DB7362190538669B9D3F6B06ACA` | Seven LocomotorSet bodies together, zero non-relocation differences; scoped base-view 83-byte vector deleting dtor and 7-byte complete dtor also byte exact. |
| `snapshot_e_dtor_export_probe/Snapshot.cpp` | `B93F9639C48BB9F5BD211242CEC43B11BCEF1847B35BEB3D87E7C2A626E2CC2D` | Independently emits real `??_ESnapshot@@UAEPAXI@Z` exact 83/83 with five relocs and Snapshot complete dtor exact 7/7. Its vtable is `[E, _purecall, _purecall, _purecall]`. |

The seven LocomotorSet bodies in the combined provider are:

| Retail RVA | C++ symbol | Extent | Relocs | Non-relocation differences |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 001B7450 | `??0LocomotorSet@@QAE@XZ` | 35 | 1 | 0 |
| 001B7480 | `?LoadPostProcess@LocomotorSet@@UAEXXZ` | 1 | 0 | 0 |
| 001B7490 | `?GetSnapshotName@LocomotorSet@@UAEPBDXZ` | 6 | 1 | 0 |
| 001B98B0 | `?clear@LocomotorSet@@QAEXXZ` | 113 | 1 | 0 |
| 001BA9E0 | `??1LocomotorSet@@UAE@XZ` | 147 | 11 | 0 |
| 001BAAA0 | `?DoXfer@LocomotorSet@@UAEXAAVXfer@@@Z` | 576 | 20 | 0 |
| 001BBC10 | `??_GLocomotorSet@@UAEPAXI@Z` | 30 | 2 | 0 |

The DoXfer COMDAT section has a trailing `0xCC` pad at +576, also present in
the existing matched `LocomotorSet_xfer.cpp` object and retail. The body ends
at 576. `loco_adoption_probe/audit.py` prints every relocation. LocomotorSet's
emitted vtable has exactly four slots, `[??_ELocomotorSet,
LoadPostProcess, GetSnapshotName, DoXfer]`; COFF's `??_E` is a weak external
alias to the defined, byte-exact `??_GLocomotorSet` 30-byte body. Retail
vtable VA0109DF3C has corresponding targets through ILTs 3333E, 1DEDA,
101E5, and 03DA0. BFME exported ParticleSystemInfo and DefaultAlphaModuleInfo
tables independently establish this virtual order.

## Eighth-body identity and lifecycle

`base_identity_audit.py` reads the retail bytes. Snapshot vtable VA01073744
has slot 0 VA0043FA3A, an E9 ILT to RVA0005C550; slots 1-3 are `_purecall`.
The already matched `Snapshot::~Snapshot` RVA0005C520/7 installs the same
vptr and is PE-exported at ILT1C80. RVA0005C550 runs 83 bytes ending in
`ret 4` at +50, followed by CC padding. Its ECX receiver is a 4-byte Snapshot
element, and its stack flag's bit 2 invokes CRT vector destructor iterator
RVA009F6D76 with element size 4 and the **matched Snapshot destructor ILT
1C80** callback. Bit 1 selects vector delete RVA00881EF0 or scalar delete
RVA00881EB0; the scalar path installs vptr VA01073744. `callees.py 0x5C550
83` reports exactly those three direct callees. The existing ledger name
`BfmeThingDMB::bfmeGoDMB` is a wrong identity; the evidence supports
`??_ESnapshot@@UAEPAXI@Z`. The unrelated `??_GSnapshot` claim at
RVA008E2260 remains separate identity debt and was not touched.

In an abstract four-slot Snapshot scratch class, marking only its virtual
destructor `__declspec(dllexport)` makes VC7 emit the real 83-byte vector
deleting destructor in C++: five relocation sites +12 callback VA00401C80,
+1E CRT iterator, +29 vector delete, +3D base vtable, +45 scalar delete.
The `.drectve` exports only `??1Snapshot@@UAE@XZ`, consistent with the retail
export table; the vector wrapper is not exported. The scoped, address-derived
base view in `loco_adoption_probe` uses the same compiler mechanism and
reproduces the same 83-byte body, 7-byte base dtor, and purecall vtable.
These are two *alternative source models for one retail body*, not two
identities to land. The parent must select one coherent binding after the
Snapshot header/provider conflict is resolved.

## Incidental helpers and ABI views

The combined provider includes canonical BFME WWLib `ascii_string.h` and
`StringBase<char>`. Its embedded LocomotorSet strings at +18/+1C are
zero-initialized. Complete destruction calls the matched
`StringBase<char>::releaseBuffer` RVA00887940 directly at +39 for +1C, then
+46 for +18. DoXfer's two temporary-string exits also call that release
body directly. Six incidental AsciiString/StringBase constructor, destructor,
and `str()` COMDATs all have retail instruction bytes and relocs, with
COFF selection `2` (any). The provider does not depend on an external ZH
`AsciiString::~AsciiString` for its members.

The AI TU's ZH 8-byte-header AsciiString has the same 4-byte handle but emits
a different 39-byte `??1AsciiString` and differing `str()` COMDAT. The older
native census `census-6d8194ec0f/selected.map` already selects those names
from `OCLUpdate.obj`; this is pre-existing allocator/provider debt and the
previously landed AI `.set(...)` cleanup must be preserved. Do not claim AI
as safely linked merely because its constructor bytes match.

To respect header adoption, the latest provider uses address-derived
`Rva001BAAA0XferView`, `Rva003ADD7NameKeyGeneratorView`, and
`Rva001BAAA0LocomotorStoreView`; `Xfer`, `NameKeyGenerator`, and
`LocomotorStore` themselves are only forward declarations. BFME Xfer dispatch
slots used by DoXfer are +10 light CRC, +28 version, +7C short, +08 storing,
+68 string, +30 snapshot, +78 int, +8C bool, exactly as the retail virtual
calls show. The available `shims/xfer/Common/Xfer.h` documents only slot +24
as BFME; later slots are still ZH and cannot be adopted here. The available
NameKeyGenerator/LocomotorStore headers transitively include the incompatible
ZH AsciiString and, for the latter, ZH LocomotorSet. Their two view calls are
source-local `/alternatename` bridges to independently matched canonical
`NameKeyGenerator::nameToKey(char const*)` body0008FFC0 via ILT3ADD7 and
`LocomotorStore::newLocomotor` body001B6920 via ILT119E1. No new retail
identity or pin is asserted by those view names. Global pointers retain the
canonical `TheNameKeyGenerator` and `TheLocomotorStore` decorations.

`LocomotorSet` itself still has two incompatible header families: the AI TU
uses a BFME-sized overlay of ZH AsciiString and donor classes, while the
canonical lifecycle provider needs the WWLib StringBase AsciiString. The
scratch provider's local `LocomotorSet` definition cannot simply be copied
as another same-name production declaration. A coherent scoped BFME header
or proved ABI view must unify class size 0x24, method access/decorations,
and four virtual slots across AI/Locomotor users without importing ZH
allocator behavior. `docs/header_adoption.md` explicitly leaves Snapshot
unsettled because of multiple incompatible headers; no global Snapshot
migration is proposed. The one-slot address-derived Locomotor deletion view
in `clear()` is supported by retail +1D..+21 (`push 1; call [vptr]`) and avoids
importing the ZH Locomotor header into the WWLib TU.

## Native-selected blockers and production file map

1. **Old strong LocomotorSet providers.** Official
   `game/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Locomotor.cpp` defines
   wrong-layout strong canonical constructor (line 2515), nonvirtual
   destructor (2543), ZH `crc`/`xfer`/`loadPostProcess` (2552/2563/2621),
   and `clear` (2667). It also emits the currently selected incompatible
   LocomotorSet vtable. Root must remove/replace these coherently with all
   37 matched rows in that TU preserved. The existing exact generic bodies
   in `S2ZeroFillCtors.cpp`, `Bfme5MultiMemberVectorDtors.cpp`,
   `Bfme5CountedClears.cpp`, `Rva001B7480Noop.cpp`, and
   `LiteralNameGetters_01.cpp` must be rehomed without two real identities
   per address. Existing `LocomotorSet_xfer.cpp` body is exact but ZH-named;
   remove/repoint its sole row if the new provider owns DoXfer. Do not edit
   `game/gen_small/dtors_002.cpp`; replace the RVA001BBC10 gen-dtor ledger
   row through add_match.
2. **Snapshot provider selection.** The native-selected `??_7Snapshot@@6B@`
   in the older census comes from
   `game/GameEngine/Source/Common/RTS/TeamFactoryCtorThunk.cpp`, which locally
   defines a ZH three-slot Snapshot. There are many other donor Snapshot
   declarations. Merely adding the exact eighth body or a DIR32 pin does
   not ensure the selected table's four-slot lifecycle. The scoped
   `Rva01073744SnapshotBase` avoids altering unrelated donor classes and
   emits the correct four-slot table, but its own export/body identity is
   distinct from the canonical Snapshot provider. The right source binding
   and one-body identity migration need a selected-definition check.
3. **AI bases and donor strings.** Parent's independent audit found current
   selected `??1UpdateModule@@MAE@XZ` from OCLUpdate has wrong 32-byte body
   despite a scratch exact 25-byte candidate; protected ObjectModule's
   selected destructor is wrong 18 bytes while retail is 7. AI's own ZH
   AsciiString provider selection remains wrong as described above. This
   widens a fully safe native AI port beyond these eight bodies.

The proposed final source destinations are
`game/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/Update/AIUpdate.cpp` (replace its
constructor and remove the old named naked thunk in
`.../Update/AIUpdateInterfaceCtorThunk.cpp`), a BFME LocomotorSet provider
under `game/GameEngine/Source/GameLogic/Object/`, and the existing
`game/GameEngine/Source/Common/System/Snapshot.cpp` for the canonical eighth
identity if a source/header route is proven. The diagnostic `/Ibuild/...`
compile include in the AI scratch source must be removed. Existing
`inputs/reference/shims/aiupdatelayout/GameLogic/Module/AIUpdate.h`,
`GameLogic/LocomotorSet.h`, `Common/Module.h`, and
`GameLogic/Module/UpdateModule.h` would require staged, full-gate changes;
their scratch variants and hashes remain in `exact_handoff.md`. Root owns
the ledger, pins, header gate, and Git.

Do not apply a partial source patch yet. Once these definitions have a
coherent production model, use `tools/add_match.py --replace-rva` or
`--replace-existing` on each claimed extent, retain durable tombstones for
wrong identities, run pin_consistency/name/adoption guards, scoped gates for
all changed rows including AI's 59 retained rows, and the shrink-only full
header gate. Existing unrelated native COMDAT debt can be documented, but
newly false vtables, allocator selection, or body routes cannot be masked by
pins.

## Reproduction

```powershell
$env:PYTHONPATH = Join-Path (Get-Location) 'build\python-deps'
$py = 'C:\Users\spiky\.cache\codex-runtimes\codex-primary-runtime\dependencies\python\python.exe'
& $py tools/probe.py build/sol_ai_canonical/eh_global_new_probe/AIUpdate.cpp '??0AIUpdateInterface@@QAE@PAVThing@@PBVModuleData@@@Z' 0x0027F4B0 --size 1237
& $py build/sol_ai_canonical/loco_adoption_probe/audit.py
& $py tools/probe.py build/sol_ai_canonical/loco_adoption_probe/LocomotorSetProvider.cpp '??_ERva01073744SnapshotBase@@UAEPAXI@Z' 0x0005C550 --size 83
& $py build/sol_ai_canonical/snapshot_e_dtor_export_probe/audit.py
& $py build/sol_ai_canonical/base_identity_audit.py
& $py tools/callees.py 0x0005C550 83
```
